verification_report.summary: Checked all 1 proof items; 1 item(s) failed or were blocked.

gaps.issue: The finite-energy conclusion is based solely on \Cref{thm:bj-e1-basic}, whose statement is absent from the dependency context; the proof does not otherwise derive that a bounded omega-psh function belongs to E^1.

The formula (n+1)E_omega(psi)=sum_{j=0}^n integral psi d mu_j is obtained from undeclared references \eqref{eq:ch46-pure-pairing-as-integrals} and \eqref{eq:bj-energy-definition}. Their exact statements and normalizations are unavailable, so this central deduction cannot be checked.

gaps.location: pi_8c8a3231e8159bc67c57eafb, proof paragraph 2, extension to bounded functions
gaps.issue: Validity of the identity for arbitrary bounded omega-psh psi depends on decreasing PL approximation and continuity assertions attributed to \Cref{thm:bj-mixed-ma} and \Cref{prop:ch46-energy-usc}, item \cref{itm:ch46-Eusc:decreasing}. No corresponding premise statements are supplied, and the approximation/limit argument is not proved.

The claims that every mixed measure mu_j has mass one and that mu_0=V^{-1}omega^n=delta_{v_triv} rely on \Cref{prop:ch46-pl-measure}, item \cref{itm:ch46-pl-ma:mass}, and \Cref{lem:ch47-three-normalizations}, none of which occurs in the supplied premise context. These claims are essential to the refinement and bounds.

gaps.location: pi_8c8a3231e8159bc67c57eafb, sharpness remark, toric range and supremum
gaps.issue: The identification of phi_u-1 with the stated weighted Fubini--Study function, monotonicity with respect to its weights, and the evaluation giving supremum zero are not derived. The cited \Cref{prop:ch49-toric-green} is undeclared, so the assertions -1<=psi<=0 and sup psi=0 are not fully verified.

gaps.location: pi_8c8a3231e8159bc67c57eafb, sharpness remark, toric energy computation
gaps.issue: The equality E_omega(phi_u)=1/(n+1), and hence E_omega(psi)=-n/(n+1), depends on the unstated energy formula in \Cref{prop:ch49-toric-green}, item \cref{itm:ch49-tg:energy}. Merely giving f_P(e_1) and the barycenter coordinate does not establish the result without that formula and its conventions.
The claimed energy -1/3 for max{log|m_p|,-1} on projective two-space is supported only by the unavailable \Cref{ex:ch46-toric-p2}; no computation or declared premise verifies it.

The assertion that \Cref{ex:ch49-conic} supplies a non-toric equality case in dimension two is only a citation to an unavailable internal example, with neither its construction nor its energy computation provided.
